issues.desc: index.json has priority=high but neither the title ("Auto-bump patch version on DONE merge to local main (sync 3 version points)") nor the description contains any of the canonical riskSignals keywords (auth/password/token/migration/destructive/state machine/guard/gate/git restore/reset/production/incident/hotfix/PII/GDPR/breaking change), and no riskSignals field exists in index.json. The description mentions "main write-lock" and "DONE post-merge effect" which carry gate-adjacent semantics, but no literal keyword match is present. Advisory: consider adding riskSignals or confirming this is a user-explicit high priority.

Consider adding a user-visible log line during DONE merge that confirms the auto-bump happened (e.g. Auto-bumped version 0.3.9 -> 0.3.10 across 3 sync points). Without this, the bump is silent and the operator must check git log or lattice --version to confirm. Not blocking since the existing dist-rebuild is also silent and the operator primarily cares that it happens, not that it announces itself.
